definitions.any_verdict_correct: at least one sampled answer has the gold verdict; guard and fact correctness are reported separately
definitions.any_strict_correct: at least one sampled answer has the gold verdict and all independently verified core facts/citations
definitions.zero_reward_variance: all candidates completed and all have trusted numeric rewards, which are equal
definitions.needs_review: Some evidence or fields remain unresolved; an independent verified error can still establish a negative reward.
definitions.reward_counts: Counts use reward only; unresolved and truncated answers retain null.
